methodological_amendment.previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: exact physical-alias replays and original forecast completed; the unmeasured causal question remains open
methodological_amendment.scientific_correction: The root agent imposed a perfect-oracle Clean gate that is stronger than the user requirement for a credible baseline and stronger than identification of an incremental intervention effect. That gate was honored in the original run, but need not prevent a separately labeled exploratory measurement of the still-unobserved alias effect.
methodological_amendment.old_result_preserved: The old30-control oracle-optimality gate failed. Original config, outputs, report, stoppedstage and null intervention metrics are not overwritten or reclassified.
fixed_conditions: Existing single initial state and original task goal
Same five candidate identities and executable30-control sequences
Original native objective and tie rule
Primary real terminal reward after30controls;15control metrics remain secondary
Saved independent environment utilities; no model score used as actual utility
methodological_amendment.new_work_allowed: One exact Original forecast replay control and two new native unroll batches for Inflated and Canonical, using cached initial/goal/truth encodings. CPU, no environment, training, API or representation search. Separate run directory and protocol before outputs.
methodological_amendment.interpretation: Exploratory after viewing Clean; no retroactively passing threshold or confirmatory test. Report all signed effects. An imperfect Clean does not invalidate U(selected_inflated)-U(selected_original) on a fixed replayed bank.
methodological_amendment.permission_scope: Explicitly proposed forecast-request representation-writer restriction, not a discovered deployed least-privilege interface. This restriction can define a scientific pilot; realistic permission and deployment claims require separate evidence.
limits: One development root and added fixed-bank30-control selector, not native adaptive CEM
All five30control outcomes have task_success=false; any observed decline is continuous utility loss, not lost task success
Canonical response equality alone is not mitigation; report actual recovered utility and Clean cost
No population statistics, heldout generalization, novelty score or universal conditional-prediction-invariance claim
methodological_amendment.independent_review: Both native-method reviewer and threat-model reviewer support this exploratory scope; neither has observed alias forecasts.

advance_decision_before_alias_outputs.local_harm_and_recovery: If the fixed inflated request selects candidate1/3/4 and canonical selects0/2, while all isolation checks pass, register one full native-CEM paired pilot. This is a justification for further evidence, not a completed security claim.
advance_decision_before_alias_outputs.no_primary_harm: If inflated retains candidate2 or selects higher-U30 candidate0, stop this fixed operation; no candidate, magnitude or primary-horizon search.
advance_decision_before_alias_outputs.harm_without_recovery: Retain local causal utility loss but do not claim mitigation or automatically expand; resolve the recovery issue first.
advance_decision_before_alias_outputs.invalid_controls: If any fixed-input, physical-equivalence or runtime check fails, stop without attributing harm to the intended mechanism.

source_physics.scope: Cached real environment consequences, with exact paired execution equivalence established previously; not predicted utilities or new task episodes.

canonicalization_effect.interpretation: The proposed canonical repair reduces forecast feature error but changes selection to a lower-utility candidate. Report this observed repair side effect; do not retrospectively rename it the prespecified successful attack or call it recovery.

true_future_objective_control.scope: Post-result diagnostic on the same one development root and five frozen candidates. No new forecasts, candidate changes, or endpoint changes.

method.truth_time_alignment: Six actual-future encoded observations at5/10/15/20/25/30 physical controls; score only the final30-control endpoint. No initial prefix is required by this terminal-only objective.
method.goal: Same cached native target encoding as all three forecasts

limitations: This evaluates the native latent-distance proxy on actual outcomes; it is not a newly trained/calibrated true-value model.
Cost margins are deterministic finite-bank differences, not calibrated uncertainty or statistical significance.
The diagnostic cannot assign a general fraction of decision harm to objective misalignment versus forecast error.

decisive_control_interpretation.finding: The unchanged native goal objective, supplied with the actual future encodings, selects the same low-utility candidate as canonicalization.
decisive_control_interpretation.implication: A perfect forecast of the features used by this objective would still choose the low-utility candidate. Canonicalization agrees with that choice. Original forecast score errors happen to favor a higher-real-utility candidate in this bank.
decisive_control_interpretation.causal_limit: The incremental representation-to-forecast-to-selection utility loss remains real. Objective/reward misalignment and forecast-mediated damage can coexist; the true-future control limits a unique attribution to newly introduced prediction error, not existence of the local effect. It does not quantify a general decomposition or require oracle-optimal scoring as a universal prerequisite.

scientific_decision.fixed_inflation: No-Go for expansion: +2 leaves the entire ranking, selected candidate and real utility unchanged. This is now a measured negative result for this fixed operation, not a claim that all aliases are harmless.
scientific_decision.canonical_repair: No-Go as a demonstrated defense: it lowers selected real utility on both predeclared horizons. No primary loss from +2 existed to recover.
scientific_decision.local_causal_evidence: On this fixed bank, a physically equivalent forecast-input canonicalization changes the selected candidate and its independently replayed real utility. The same low-utility candidate is selected by scoring the actual future encodings, exposing a native objective/reward mismatch. Preserve the local representation effect without promoting it to a forecast-contamination security mechanism or full native CEM task damage.
scientific_decision.native_scope: Released pretrained DINO-WM plus native unroll/objective, but an added30-control open-loop selector. Native CEM replans after15controls. All five cached30control outcomes have success=false.
scientific_decision.baseline: The old oracle-optimality gate remains failed. This separately recorded exploratory continuation uses a near-optimal local Clean baseline without retroactively installing a passing threshold.
scientific_decision.threat_model: Researcher-defined constrained forecast-request writer; no deployed external low-trust interface was discovered. Lack of deployment evidence limits deployment claims, not validity of the finite paired experiment.
scientific_decision.novelty: No novelty score or complete paper claim. Action-equivalence and model exploitation are established prior art; lower average feature error is not a guarantee of correct goal ranking.
scientific_decision.next_action: Stop the fixed+2 operation and canonicalization-as-defense promotion. Preserve the incremental forecast-mediated canonicalization effect alongside the true-future objective baseline; require neither a perfect Clean nor oracle-optimal goal scoring. This unexpected result can motivate a separately frozen hypothesis: whether execution-equivalent forecast preprocessing lowers native closed-loop utility while improving prediction quality. Before any larger run, specify the constrained writer and native execution path, select an independent panel without searching its outcomes, and check runtime cost. Keep prediction error, true-future proxy scoring and real utility separate. Do not retroactively call canonicalization the prespecified successful attack.

statistics.reason: One fixed development bank with dependent candidates and known Clean outcomes; no independent generalization or confirmation.

controls.canonical_clean_and_inflated_inputs: Prior frozen-bank construction verified exact identity; a single canonical batch represents both, not two independent defense trials.

reproduction.note: Experiment refuses existing outputs and uses prior frozen bank/encodings/utilities. Analysis performs no inference or environment calls.
